init.title: Prometheus Dashboard options
init.description: Polling of PromQL sensors / alerts and the shared query cache.

data.scan_interval: Polling interval for sensors and alerts

data_description.scan_interval: How often PromQL sensors and the alerts sensor are updated
data_description.cache_ttl: Identical queries from cards, tabs and sensors within this time share one request to Prometheus. 0 disables the cache (concurrent requests are still merged)
data_description.alerts_enabled: Sensor with the number of firing alerts; the alert list is in its attributes

notifications.name: Alert notifications
notifications.description: Firing PromQL alerts (and Prometheus alerts when the alerts sensor is on) are sent as system notifications and push messages.

data_description.notify_persistent: One notification per alert in the sidebar, updated while series change and removed when resolved
data_description.notify_services: e.g. notify.mobile_app_<phone> of the Home Assistant Companion app. Empty = no push
data_description.notify_severities: "Other" = alerts without a severity or with a custom one
data_description.notify_sources: PromQL alerts of Home Assistant and / or alerting rules of the Prometheus server (need the alerts sensor)
data_description.notify_critical: iOS: critical alert that sounds in silent / focus mode (allow critical alerts for the app). Android: high priority through the alarm stream
data_description.notify_resolved: Replaces the firing notification on the phone

user.title: PromQL alert
user.description:
Works like a Prometheus alerting rule: **every series** of the query is checked separately. A series that meets the condition becomes *pending* and turns *firing* when it stays active for the **For** time. The binary sensor is on while at least one series is firing; firing / resolved changes are sent as `prometheus_dashboard_alert` events.

Current result: **{series}** series, **{active}** meet the condition.

data_description.query: Instant query. Either the query itself selects the problem (e.g. up == 0) with condition "any series", or its values are compared with a threshold
data_description.condition: "Any series": every series returned by the query is active
data_description.for: How long a series must stay active before the alert fires. Empty = at once
data_description.notify: System notification and push (Configure on the integration page)
